stories.title: Follow live: Hernandez, Freeman connect on pair of homers as Dodgers lead Braves
Eagles All-Pro RT Johnson retires to 'focus on my mental health'
stories.summary: Eagles two-time All-Pro right tackle Lane Johnson announced his retirement Tuesday, ending a 14-year career spent entirely in Philadelphia.

stories.title: Dodgers move struggling Ohtani to No. 5 in lineup for NLDS Game 3
stories.summary: Manager Dave Roberts juggled the Dodgers' lineup for Game 3 of the NL Division Series against the Braves, moving DH Shohei Ohtani to the No. 5 spot.

stories.title: NFL refs union to challenge severity of 2 officials' suspensions
stories.summary: The NFL Referees Association said it will challenge the severity of the suspensions of two officials for unprofessional conduct.

stories.title: Guardians, White Sox to start openers as Chicago looks to sweep ALDS
stories.summary: The White Sox and Guardians will both start openers in Game 3 of the ALDS, with Chicago looking to complete the sweep while Cleveland aims to extend its season.
